name: Default
shortDescription: Experimental alternative web client for Jellyfin built with Vue, served as a static web app that connects from the browser to an existing Jellyfin server.

alerts.message: This is only a client: it needs an existing Jellyfin server reachable over HTTPS from the browser, since an http:// server is blocked as mixed content. Enter its address on first visit, or prefill it with DEFAULT_SERVERS.
Jellyfin Vue is experimental and has no stable releases; upstream only supports its latest unstable build, pinned here by date.
